name: D mod
description: Predictive input buffer prank. Forces safe mode while active.

toggle-key.name: Toggle hotkey
toggle-key.description: Press this in-game to turn D mod on or off.

toggle-popup.name: Show popup when toggled
toggle-popup.description: Off by default so the toggle is quiet.

max-buffer.name: Max buffer (ticks)
max-buffer.description: Longest a click can be held back. 1 tick = ~4 ms (240 TPS). 0 turns the buffer off.

look-ahead.name: Look-ahead (ticks)
look-ahead.description: How far ahead each trial run checks for death. 24 ticks = ~100 ms. Higher is smarter but can stutter.
